dialogues.speaker: Albizzi
dialogues.text: Everyone, I have returned. I come with the long-awaited Marquis and their followers to search for the lost origins of our clan!

dialogues.speaker: Giant Guard
dialogues.text: Well, we weren't told anything about that this morning. Get out of here. Leave us alone.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The giant guards scoop you all up and throw you outside.\nNo one is able to fight back.

dialogues.speaker: Giant Guard
dialogues.text: Thank you for being honest and surrendering willingly. Now, we will politely escort you out of the restricted area.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The giant guards scoop you all up and gently places you outside.\nThe whole process is extremely civilized.

dialogues.speaker: Albizzi
dialogues.text: This is the guards' headquarters. If we can just explain the situation, I'm sure the giant guard will be less hostile towards us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello...

dialogues.speaker: Voice From Behind the Door
dialogues.text: What are you doing? I'm busy reminiscing about old times with a photo of my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Albizzi
dialogues.text: I know that voice. Is that Winston?

dialogues.speaker: Winston
dialogues.text: Hahaha, so, you come crawling back... I told you, I am your only friend in this world. What were you thinking, running off on a mission with two complete strangers?

dialogues.speaker: Winston
dialogues.text: You were so naive. "Oh, I'll make friends with them, I know I will!" But in the end, I alone am waiting for you. I alone am your friend.

dialogues.speaker: Albizzi
dialogues.text: #That's not true... It's not just those two. There's {NICKNAME}-Marquis and {M#his}{F#her} companion, too.

dialogues.speaker: Winston
dialogues.text: ...You made other friends behind my back!? Well, look at you, Albizzi, all grown up... That's the last straw. Get out of here! I never want to see your face again!

dialogues.speaker: Albizzi
dialogues.text: Actually, no. Why don't you lift the emergency measures for a second and let me in? I have a VIP with me and we're very close to solving the mystery of our sacred site.

dialogues.speaker: Winston
dialogues.text: I said, get out!!!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen Text
dialogues.text:
Winston sounds the alarm. The giant guards arrive, scoop everyone up, and place you outside.
"You and Winston both need your own space right now. Your friendship needs a cooling-off period."
The guards kindly offer relationship advice.
The whole process is unusually civilized.

dialogues.speaker: Giant Guard
dialogues.text: Arrest these suspicious individuals, and their associate Albizzi! You're coming with me!

dialogues.speaker: Giant Guard
dialogues.text: Suspicious individuals detected! I don't know what law you've broken, but we're currently at the highest level of alert. Come with us, turn yourselves in!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Everyone scatters. You hear Cappet's voice shouting out, "It's every man for himself!"\nAfter the guards have gone, you regroup back at the same place. It looks like no one was caught...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: Let's try that again, shall we?
